plan.brief:
Phase 6: Cytotoxic Drug Handling & Storage domain layer
- Add cytotoxic drug entity/domain model with specialized handling requirements (PPE, segregated storage, pregnant-woman handling restrictions per A6)
- Add cytotoxic handling domain service with validation logic
- Add cytotoxic API contracts (Zod schemas) and API controller/module
- Register cytotoxic module in AppModule
- Add cytotoxic domain tests and API e2e tests
- Verify: all 8 packages build green, lint clean, tests pass
